STUDIO V3 / CASSETTE 01

Configure the cassette module.

Three non-residential programs and an experimental Matrix grid. Geometry and placement rules are supplied by OBTP System.

Studio and Workshop: 1–18 repeated modules in 600 mm steps. Sauna uses complete S/M/L plan studies. Fixed 4.572 m setting-out width and 2.1 m walls.

Hot room + small indoor hall + required outside shower. Optional side storage and outdoor seat share the shower side; no annex structure is generated.

Sauna layout and construction holds ↗

Cells coordinate a layout; they are not separate rooms or floor cassettes. This study allows up to eight columns and restricts rows to the outside-wall area cap.

Design notes and model limits

Research prototype. Studio, Workshop and Sauna use the revised R90 geometry; Matrix reuses the 600 mm wall family with its own unresolved corners. Plywood panels are shown by default; use Cut to inspect the interior. Contact between modules does not establish connection strength. Fasteners, anchorage, joist spans and envelope details await engineering and physical tests.

Windows and doors: on hold for every preset. Workshop access and sauna hall and outdoor shower are planning allowances only; no opening, partition, waterproofing or services are generated. Matrix corners, cassette junctions, perimeter closure and bearing are unengineered.
